title: UC Davis Internal Medicine Funding System
description: Architecting a full-stack funding workflow platform projected to eliminate 250+ hours of manual processing annually by digitizing 500+ departmental submissions. Engineered relational data models with Prisma ORM and MongoDB to manage funding requests, multi-stage approval states, and full revision history with end-to-end type safety. Built a tokenized, email-based approval system via Resend, enabling asynchronous multi-reviewer workflows. Enforced strict runtime data validation using Zod schemas.

title: Orbit
description: Building a social activity discovery platform for college students featuring a galaxy-themed UI. Developed iOS app using SwiftUI with Combine for reactive state management. Implemented features including activity discovery, real-time group chat, and structured voting systems for coordinating hangouts and events.

title: MuscleMax Startup
description: Spearheading development of a cross-platform fitness app integrating a custom EMG device to deliver real-time muscle activity insights. Designed and implemented a BLE communication layer using react-native-ble-plx, enabling low-latency data streaming from proprietary hardware. Architected a real-time data pipeline with SQLite and Node.js to support live EMG signal graphing and persistent session history. Directing a 5-person cross-functional team across software, hardware, and business.

title: GitHub Data Fetcher
description: Developed a Rust CLI tool that interacts with the GitHub REST API to retrieve repository and issue metadata, using SOLID principles in the architecture. Stored structured JSON objects in Redis for fast retrieval and caching, improving query efficiency and reducing API calls by 80%. Applied asynchronous programming, error handling, and modular design to build a reliable and efficient backend data pipeline.

title: Top Garden Landscaping & Design
description: Built and deployed a responsive client website using React and Tailwind CSS. Improved client visibility and customer inquiries by 40% through optimized design. Applied efficient communication and design iteration with the client and teammate.
